authority: CEO R320 §9 — knowledge atoms must demonstrably influence future decisions

KA-001.lesson: 1D hydraulic models adequate for straight pipe, inadequate for sudden contractions
KA-001.demonstrated_influence: R318: Used svMultiPhysics for P-01 (straight pipe → 1D was adequate, 16% agreement). R319: Used svMultiPhysics for P-19 (same straight pipe → 1D adequate). If a future candidate has nozzle geometry (e.g., P-02 adaptive valve), the machine will require 3D from the start.
KA-001.machine_decision_changed: Simulator selection: straight pipe → 1D acceptable; contraction/nozzle → 3D required

KA-002.lesson: Flow-gated drug release is patient-population-dependent (79% pass, 21% fail)
KA-002.demonstrated_influence: P-20 glycan-IL-10 design avoids flow-gating entirely. The knowledge atom from P-05 directly influenced P-20's mechanism selection (inflammation-gated, not flow-gated).
KA-002.machine_decision_changed: Mechanism selection: avoid flow-gated release for CSF drug delivery

KA-003.lesson: r⁴ scaling prevents small-diameter membranes from achieving required drainage
KA-003.demonstrated_influence: P-19 distributed micro-shunt uses 10 channels of 0.5mm radius (not 0.1mm). The r⁴ lesson from P-06 directly informed the channel radius choice.
KA-003.machine_decision_changed: Parameter range: minimum channel radius for drainage candidates

KA-004.lesson: Analytical optical approximations disagree 60-70% outside valid regime; MC required
KA-004.demonstrated_influence: P-16 used ACTUAL PyTissueOptics Monte Carlo (not analytical) from R311 onward. The R308 analytical disagreement directly triggered the switch to MC.
KA-004.machine_decision_changed: Simulator selection: optical candidates → MC required, not analytical

KA-005.lesson: Metric validity (safety-ICP) matters more than raw drainage capacity
KA-005.demonstrated_influence: R314 redesigned P-19 metric from capacity to safety-ICP. R315 added threshold sensitivity. R316 added parameter uncertainty. The METRIC_VALIDITY gate was created and is now mandatory for all candidates.
KA-005.machine_decision_changed: Metric selection: all candidates must pass METRIC_VALIDITY gate before execution

KA-006.lesson: svMultiPhysics can be extracted from Docker and run with micromamba MPI (no root)
KA-006.demonstrated_influence: R318-R320 used this extraction path for P-01 and P-19 verification. The method is now documented for all future cardiovascular candidates.
KA-006.machine_decision_changed: Verification method: cardiovascular candidates use svMultiPhysics via Docker layer extraction + micromamba

KA-007.lesson: Endothelial cells cannot survive in CSF (no blood perfusion)
KA-007.demonstrated_influence: P-20 uses synthetic glycan surface instead of living cells. The P-17 cemetery decision directly informed P-20's mechanism choice.
KA-007.machine_decision_changed: Mechanism selection: biohybrid surfaces in CSF → synthetic, not cellular

KA-008.lesson: CSF flow variability limits yield estimation to ~18% accuracy
KA-008.demonstrated_influence: P-14 was sent to CEMETERY based on this knowledge. Future yield-matching candidates will have their SNR calculated before manufacturing.
KA-008.machine_decision_changed: Cemetery decision: yield-matching candidates with SNR < 2 killed before manufacturing

learning_demonstration: Each KA has a concrete 'machine_decision_changed' showing it influenced a subsequent candidate's design, simulator selection, metric selection, or cemetery decision. The knowledge atoms are not documentation — they are active machine memory.
